transcript.en: Hi Jeannie.
transcript.zh: 你好，珍妮

transcript.en: How's it going?
transcript.zh: 最近怎么样

transcript.en: Oh, hello Dan.
transcript.zh: 你好，丹

transcript.en: Pretty well, thanks.
transcript.zh: 我很好，谢谢

transcript.en: Have you managed to get the money for the course yet?
transcript.zh: 你筹到上学的钱了吗

transcript.en: Yes, that's all sorted out now, thanks.
transcript.zh: 是的，现在都解决了，谢谢

transcript.en: It took long enough, though.
transcript.zh: 尽管花了很长时间

transcript.en: It was practically a year ago that I applied to my local council for a grant, and it took them six months to turn me down.
transcript.zh: 差不多一年前我向地方政府申请助学金，他们花了六个月的时间拒绝了我的申请

transcript.en: That's really slow.
transcript.zh: 太慢了

transcript.en: And I thought I was eligible for government funding, but it seems I was mistaken.
transcript.zh: 我想我有资格申请政府资助，但是看起来我弄错了

transcript.en: So then I asked the boss of the company I used to work for if they would sponsor me, and much to my surprise, he said they'd make a contribution.
transcript.zh: 所以我之后问我曾经公司的老板是否他们能资助我，令我吃惊的是他说他们可以出资。

transcript.en: But what about college grants and scholarships?
transcript.zh: 但是学院奖学金怎么样

transcript.en: There must be some you could apply for.
transcript.zh: 肯定有你能申请的项目

transcript.en: Yes, there are, but they're all so small that I decided to leave them until I was desperate.
transcript.zh: 是有一些，但都太少了，我决定先不申请，等急需的时候再说，

transcript.en: Uhuh.
transcript.zh: 嗯

transcript.en: And in fact I didn't need to apply.
transcript.zh: 其实我不用申请了

transcript.en: My parents had been saying that as I already had a job, I ought to support myself through college.
transcript.zh: 我父母曾说既然我有工作，我应该自己交大学学费。

transcript.en: But in the end they took pity on me, so now I've just about got enough.
transcript.zh: 但最终他们对我表示同情，所以现在我的钱差不多够了，

transcript.en: That's good.
transcript.zh: 太好了

transcript.en: So now I can put a bit of effort into meeting people - I haven't had time so far.
transcript.zh: 所以现在我可以在社交上下点功夫了，到目前为止我还没有时间，

transcript.en: Any suggestions?
transcript.zh: 有什么建议吗

transcript.en: What about joining some college clubs?
transcript.zh: 加入一些大学俱乐部怎么样

transcript.en: Oh right.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: You joined several didn't you?
transcript.zh: 你已经加入了几个，不是吗，

transcript.en: Yes, I'm in the drama club.
transcript.zh: 是的，我加入了戏剧社。

transcript.en: It's our first performance next week, so we're rehearsing frantically, and I've got behind with my work, but it's worth it.
transcript.zh: 下周是我们第一次演出，所以我们正在疯狂的排练，我的学业都耽误了，但是值得。

transcript.en: I'm hoping to be in the spring production, too.
transcript.zh: 我还希望参加春季演出

transcript.en: I've never liked acting.
transcript.zh: 我从不喜欢表演

transcript.en: Are you doing anything else?
transcript.zh: 你还做别的事情吗

transcript.en: I enjoyed singing when I was at school, so I joined a group when I came to college.
transcript.zh: 我在学校的时候还喜欢唱歌，所以我到大学后参加了一个团体。

transcript.en: I don't think the conductor stretches us enough, though so I'll give up after the next concert.
transcript.zh: 我认为管理者不能充分发挥我们的才能，所以我将在下一个音乐会后退出。

transcript.en: And I also joined the debating society.
transcript.zh: 我还加入了辩论社

transcript.en: It's fun, but with all the rehearsing I'm doing, something has to go, and I'm afraid that's the one.
transcript.zh: 很有意思，但现在我有许多排练，不得不舍弃个别活动，恐怕就是它了。

transcript.en: Do you do any sports?
transcript.zh: 你做运动吗

transcript.en: Yes, I'm in one of the hockey teams.
transcript.zh: 是的，我加入了其中一个曲棍球队，

transcript.en: I'm not very good, but I'd really miss it if I stopped.
transcript.zh: 我打得不太好，但如果不参加了我会非常想念它。

transcript.en: I decided to try tennis when I came to college, and I'm finding it pretty tough going.
transcript.zh: 刚上大学时我决定尝试打网球，但后来发现太难了，

transcript.en: I'm simply not fit enough.
transcript.zh: 我根本没法适应

transcript.en: Nor me.
transcript.zh: 我也是

transcript.en: I think I'll give that a miss!
transcript.zh: 我想我不会参加

transcript.en: I'm hoping it'll help me to build up my stamina, but it'll probably be a long haul.
transcript.zh: 我希望它能帮我增强耐力，但是这可能是一个长期的过程。

transcript.en: Good luck.
transcript.zh: 祝你好运

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: How are you finding the course?
transcript.zh: 你觉得课程怎么样

transcript.en: I wish we had more seminars.
transcript.zh: 我希望我们能多一些研讨会

transcript.en: What?
transcript.zh: 什么

transcript.en: I'd have thought we had more than enough already.
transcript.zh: 我认为我们已经够多了

transcript.en: All those people saying clever things that I could never think of - it's quite interesting, but I wonder if I'm clever enough to be doing this course.
transcript.zh: 他们说一些我从没想过的聪明点子，很有趣，但是我想知道我是否足够聪明能应付这门课。

transcript.en: I find it helpful to listen to the other people.
transcript.zh: 我觉得聆听他人很有帮助

transcript.en: I like the way we're exploring the subject, and working towards getting insight into it.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢我们对研究题目进行探索的方式，不断努力获得更深刻的理解。

transcript.en: How do you get on with your tutor?
transcript.zh: 你和你的导师相处得怎么样

transcript.en: I don't think I'm on the same wavelength as mine, so I feel I'm not getting anything out of the tutorials.
transcript.zh: 我认为我和我的导师不合拍，所以我感觉我没有从课堂上学到任何东西，

transcript.en: It would be more productive to read a book instead.
transcript.zh: 还不如看书更有用

transcript.en: Oh, mine's very demanding.
transcript.zh: 我的导师要求很高

transcript.en: She gives me lots of feedback and advice, so I've got much better at writing essays.
transcript.zh: 她给我很多反馈和建议，所以我在论文写作方面有了很大提高

transcript.en: And she's helping me plan my revision for the end-of-year exams.
transcript.zh: 她还帮我计划年底的考试复习

transcript.en: Do tell me, I always struggle with revision.
transcript.zh: 快告诉我怎么弄的，我总是纠结于论文修改

transcript.en: Well, the first thing is to find out exactly what's required in the exams.
transcript.zh: 首先是找到考试到底要求什么

transcript.en: Mm.
transcript.zh: 嗯

transcript.en: Would it help to get hold of some past papers?
transcript.zh: 掌握一些过去的论文对此有帮助吗

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: They'll help to make it clear.
transcript.zh: 它们能帮你弄清思路

transcript.en: Right, I'll do that. Then what?
transcript.zh: 好的，我会这么做。然后是什么？

transcript.en: Then you can sort out your revision priorities, based on what's most likely to come up.
transcript.zh: 然后根据最可能出现的问题，你可以挑出优先复习的地方。

transcript.en: I put these on a card, and read them through regularly.
transcript.zh: 我把这些写在一张卡片上，时不时的读一读

transcript.en: Uhuh.
transcript.zh: 额

transcript.en: But that isn't enough in itself.
transcript.zh: 但是这还不够

transcript.en: You also need a timetable, to see how you can fit everything in, in the time available.
transcript.zh: 你还需要一张时间表，看看如何在有限的时间里完成一切，

transcript.en: Then keep it in front of you while you're studying.
transcript.zh: 然后在你学习时，把它放在你的前面。

transcript.en: I've done that before, but it hasn't helped me!
transcript.zh: 我以前这么做过，但是对我没帮助。

transcript.en: Maybe you need to do something different every day, so if you break down your revision into small tasks, and allocate them to specific days, there's more incentive to tackle them.
transcript.zh: 也许你需要每天做些不同的事情。所以如果你把复习任务分成很多小任务，并把这些小任务分配到具体的每一天，你就会有更强的动力去完成。

transcript.en: With big topics you're more likely to put off starting.
transcript.zh: 大的主题往往迟迟难以开始

transcript.en: Good idea.
transcript.zh: 好主意

transcript.en: And as I revise each topic I write a single paragraph about it - then later I can read it through quickly, and it helps fix things in my mind.
transcript.zh: 当我复习每个题目时，我会写上一段文字，之后我可以快速地阅读它，这帮我在脑海里解决很多事情。

transcript.en: That's brilliant.
transcript.zh: 太棒了

transcript.en: I also write answers to questions for the exam practice.
transcript.zh: 我也会写出一些考试问题的答案

transcript.en: It's hard to make myself do it, though!
transcript.zh: 尽管这对我来说很难

transcript.en: Well, I'll try.
transcript.zh: 我会试试

transcript.en: Thanks a lot, Jeannie.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢你，珍妮

transcript.en: That's a great help.
transcript.zh: 这很有帮助

transcript.en: No problem.
transcript.zh: 不客气

transcript.en: See you around.
transcript.zh: 回头见

transcript.en: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见
